t1.text: Radar: two layouts to choose between

n1.text: What is real in these mockups: repo names, star counts, growth curves, Trending and Hacker News data are real, collected 13-15 Nov 2026. Quality scores, Fit scores and AI text are examples or [placeholders], because those stages are not built yet.

n2.text: Choose: A shows general, personal and discussed side by side, so nothing is hidden behind a tab. B is denser and easier to sort and compare, but shows one lane at a time.
